_notice: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE. Invented text about a fictional place, written only to test grounding and citation checks. Not real facts and not training data.

documents.title: Fictional Harbor Guide
documents.text:
The fictional town of Lumen Bay has one lighthouse, built in 1902.

The Lumen Bay ferry departs every 40 minutes between 6am and 10pm.

documents.title: Fictional Council Notes
documents.text: Council notes state the Lumen Bay lighthouse was built in 1911, after a storm destroyed an earlier tower.

documents.title: Fictional Market Flyer
documents.text: The Lumen Bay night market opens on Fridays and sells smoked fish and lanterns.
